text:
incident-bot: PAGER: runtime-backpressure triggered for embed-runtime-prod. High queue depth and p95 latency spike. Pager routed to @alex

alex: On it. Looking at dashboards — k8s pending pods and long KV cache stalls. Root cause unclear, starting mitigation plan.

maria: Noted. Can we temporarily drop MAX_INFLIGHT for embed-runtime from 40 -> 10 to shed load?

alex: Yes. Plan: 1) reduce MAX_INFLIGHT to 10 for embed-service 2) increase quota for critical customers (+50%) 3) disable non-enterprise streaming 4) lower request timeout 60s -> 35s. Apply sequentially, will monitor.

jing: Quick note — lowering timeout may cause client retries. Add Retry-After and 429 with X-Reason so clients back off.

alex: Good call. Will add Retry-After: 30 and X-Rate-Reason header. Applying MAX_INFLIGHT change now. Command: 
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment embed-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"embed-runtime","env":[{"name":"MAX_INFLIGHT","value":"10"}]}]}}}}'
```

ops-bot: Change applied: embed-runtime MAX_INFLIGHT=10 on gp2 pool. Rolling update started.

maria: Seeing queue depth drop in us-east-1, aggregate throughput down ~60% — shedding effective. Any customer impact observed?

cs-rep: CS notified top 3 affected customers on rotation. No public escalations yet; we've opened tickets for monitoring customers.

samir: Taking over mitigation handoff from Alex. I'll bump quota for key redwood-inc now: `rr quota bump redwood-inc +50%`.

ops-bot: Quota change applied for redwood-inc. New limit: 1500 req/min.

alex: Next step: disable non-enterprise streaming to reduce long-tail connections. Command: `feature-flag toggle streaming=false --env=prod --scope=non-enterprise`

ops-bot: Streaming disabled for non-enterprise keys. Observed fewer long-tail connections and freed sockets.

jing: Recommend we watch for client retry churn for 5m. If retries spike, revert timeout tweak and instead incrementally raise MAX_INFLIGHT to 25.

alex: Agreed. Observability note logged to runbook. We'll keep inflight at 10 for 5m then consider bump to 20/25.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation steps recorded in /runbooks/embed-backpressure. Please ack when handoff complete.

samir: :thumbsup: Acknowledged, handoff complete. Paging returned to rotation.

alex: Monitoring p95 down from ~3.2s to ~1.1s since mitigations. No errors increase in enterprise tenants. Clearing pager unless any objections.

maria: Looks stable from infra side. If we see re-accumulation we'll run gradual inflight ramp and audit KV cache eviction metrics.

alex: Closing thread in 10m if stable. Thanks everyone.
